sources.agency_or_body: Office of the Federal Register / GPO
sources.coverage_notes: Public API for Federal Register documents, agencies, public inspection, and related metadata. The sample endpoint uses documents.json so URL smoke checks resolve; use source citations and official PDFs/govinfo links when legal precision matters.
known_gaps: FederalRegister.gov describes itself as an informational/prototype XML rendition until official status is granted.
Final legal reliance requires checking the official edition or official PDF/govinfo source.
Parser not implemented in ComplyOS v0.
